text:
maya: ran a perfetto trace on the staging gateway->runtime e2e path this morning. seeing recurring 40-120ms handshake pauses right after prefetch kicks in. link: https://perfetto.com/trace/ABC123

sam: yep saw that too on canary at ~10:12PT. looks correlated with the prefetch window shrinking to 1 from 4 in the batching heuristic. :thinking_face:

devon: KV miss spikes right when the pause happens — logs show KV_CACHE.miss_rate 2% -> 18% in ~3s. putting a few snippets below.
```
[2026-03-15T10:11:58Z] KV_CACHE: evict key_group=0 size=120->64
[2026-03-15T10:11:59Z] BATCHER: heuristic window=4->1 reason=latency_budget
[2026-03-15T10:12:01Z] RUNTIME: kernel_select: v1_shim -> v1_fast (fallback)
```

maya: nice. I attached the perfetto view — I see GPU kernel swap events (nvtx) exactly aligned with the gateway span boundary. timeline shows small gap between "client_send" and "gateway_handshake_ack" when that kernel swap occurs.

tj: may be the kernel selector is switching to a quantized kernel that has worse cold-start memory churn. nvprof/nsys sample:
```
nsys profile --output=run_prefetch_2026 -t cuda,nvtx python -m bench.requests --trace perfetto
# sample results (trimmed)
GPU memcpy HtoD  12ms  (spike)
kernel v1_fast_launch  3ms
kernel v1_shim_launch  28ms (first run)
```

kai: could be that prefetch reduces overlap so the runtime sees isolated inflight and chooses a different kernel due to a mistaken seq_len distribution estimate. small batches + kernel flip -> KV cache eviction churn -> increased host<->device copies.

sam: actionable hypotheses: 1) throttle prefetch aggressiveness when batcher window < 2, 2) pin kernel selection to maintain consistent kernel on short windows, 3) delay eviction for recently-prefetched keys for 200ms.

devon: I profiled with heap and saw device memory free/alloc noise at spike times. adding a 100ms jitter to prefetch avoided the handshake pause in a quick A/B.

maya: can someone reproduce on a dedicated node? if yes, I'd like a full nsys capture including `--sample=none --trace=nvtx,cuda` and the perfetto export. I pushed a tiny patch that disables prefetch for windows <=1: https://git.redwood/changes/2371 (test branch).

infra-bot: deploy to canary completed for commit 3f7a2b (maya/disable-prefetch-small-windows).

sam: running reproduce now on canary-3. I'll upload trace when done.

tj: thanks. if reproduced we'll try toggling kernel_selector.hysteresis to 250ms to avoid flip-flops. also worth adding metrics: kernel_switch_count per minute and kv_eviction_rate per second.

maya: agreed — I'll add those metrics to runtime telemetry and create an eval that hits short sequences to ensure no regression. keeping this thread live for traces. :white_check_mark:
